heading: Don’t miss out on millions!
description: Unclaimed lottery jackpots are more common than you think! Discover why playing with Lotto Express can help you avoid missing out on millions.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
Imagine being a lottery jackpot winner and not knowing it!

It happens more often than you’d think and it’s a key reason that playing online is much more advantageous to buying lottery tickets locally.

For example – two newly anointed millionaires in the UK who purchased tickets in April have yet to come forward. Given the recency of the draws, there could be many reasons for this. Some players don’t check immediately. Others will sit on their wins while making solid financial plans in preparation.

The amount of time it takes for a UK lottery jackpot winner to claim their prize can vary, but typically winners claim their prize within a few days or weeks of the draw. In fact, many winners claim their prize on the day of the draw or the next day. However, there have been cases where winners have taken longer to claim their prize.

According to the National Lottery in the UK, winners have 180 days from the date of the draw to claim their prize. If the prize is not claimed within this time frame, the money is forfeited and added to the National Lottery’s Good Causes fund, which distributes money to various charitable causes.

Every passing week that goes by increases the possibility that the Golden Ticket worth millions is simply lost. Presently in the UK, there is an unclaimed Euromillions ticket purchased on April 11, 2022 worth £1 million.

In 2 days, the unclaimed win will be permanently forfeited.

Unclaimed jackpots are relatively rare. The National Lottery recently reported 0.1% of prizes worth over £50,000 went unclaimed during a one year reporting period. As small as this percentage is, the aggregated prize value still came to an astounding £5.9 million in unclaimed prizes!

There is absolutely no point in playing the lottery if your tickets aren’t being taken care of. When you purchase your lottery plays at LottoExpress, you can be sure any potential wins will be tracked.
